campaign.title: Togetherness Foreverness

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: Welcome to the RSVP module for Bart and Kim's wedding.
welcome.date: We are getting married on 18 May 2019 and we would love to celebrate it with you!
welcome.no-invitation: If you have not received an invitation by letter or e-mail (yet), do get in touch so we can work out what went missing.
welcome.capacity: We would love to have everyone at as many parts of our special day as possible, but sadly that is not possible for the dinner and the reception that goes with it. If you can still tick dinner while registering, then there was a seat left for you and a possible plus one. If not, we have reached full capacity — but you are just as welcome at the dessert buffet and the party afterwards.
welcome.provisional: The details on this page are not final yet and small shifts in the schedule cannot be ruled out. This page and e-mail will be used to communicate any changes.
welcome.call-to-action: Hit RSVP (Répondez s'il vous plaît) or pick the pledge that describes you best to register!

parody.title: Kickstarter?
parody.explanation: This site is a pastiche of a very well known crowdfunding platform called Kickstarter. A place where entrepreneurs can ask for support to realise their grand ideas and projects. Support can be altruistic or tied to something specific in return. Over there they call that a pledge.
parody.our-project: And here we are, ready for our own enormous project: a life together!
parody.support:
You can support this project in any way that suits you!
e.g. a listening ear, babysitting (should it ever apply), sharing experiences…
parody.short-term: In the short term, though, the support we are after is your presence at this project's big kick-off: the wedding.
parody.hope: We hope to live one of the most beautiful days of our lives together with you.
parody.gifts: If you would like to support us in another way as well, or instead, there is always room for a little something in our pot. Other than that, we already have everything our hearts desire!

risks.title: Risks and challenges
risks.history: At the time of writing, Kim and Bart have known each other for at least nine years. They have already lived through many an adventure together, including (but not limited to) a Star Wars WArathon, exams at KU Leuven, a burglary, a house build and now the wedding preparations too.
risks.future: People change, of course, and nobody knows what the future holds. We want to actively strive and actively work towards a happy life together. An oak anniversary (80 years) is probably out of reach, but we will do our best for the Diamond Achievement™ (60 years).
risks.friends-and-family: We are nowhere near that yet, of course, and along the way the role of friends and family should certainly not be underestimated.

3.title: A Bug's Life (Important)
3.audience: This update is for everyone who registered with 'Mobile' as their contact method.
3.bug: Unfortunately there was still a small bug in the software, which meant RSVPs using that option never came through.
3.fix: The bug has been fixed as of today. If you registered with that option earlier, we currently have no record of you joining us. If that is you, could you please register once more? Pick 'E-mail' as the contact method and you will also get a confirmation by mail, so you know for certain that it worked.

1.title: The Road to Shangri-La
1.goals: The first two stretch goals are a fact!
1.anecdote-intro: So here is an exciting first anecdote about Bart and his adventures at the town hall.
1.anecdote: Yesterday Kim and I went to the town hall to sign the notice of marriage. At the end we still had to pay for the marriage booklet, at which point the lady behind the desk handed me the receipt and said: "There you go, the first piece of paper in a whole stack". Kim asked about pink rubbish bags, and after settling up a long silence fell…
1.question: Hesitantly I asked: "…and the marriage booklet?".
1.lesson: So that is another thing learned: it only comes at the wedding itself — and another step closer to our special day.
